name: Jeju (South Korea, 1969–2009)
description: A field divided diagonally from the upper fly to the lower hoist into white at the upper hoist and blue at the lower fly, with a red three-comma emblem in the upper hoist.
history: Flag of Jeju Province adopted on 5 November 1969, kept when Jeju became a Special Self-Governing Province in 2006 and used until 19 April 2009.
